sources.excerpt: $ 185.00 Lowest price 30 days before the discount: $ 185.00 Fuzzie is a guitar pedal offering a wide range of dirty tones – from mild distortion to dynamic fuzz, rich in harmonics and sustain. This Foxy Lady has the classic vibe and warmth of saturated Germanium transistors, and a clever modern design allowing her to be placed either before or after the buffer pedal without losing it’s full, dynamic sound. Her ‘Bias’ and ‘Texture’ knobs give you additional tonal flexibility allowing to dial in anything from vintage, super smooth drive to fat and aggressive fuzz. 2 in stock (can be backordered) Fuzzie Germanium Fuzz v2 quantity Add to basket Share this product Categories: Distortion / Fuzz , Pedals Previous Product Next Product Description Additional information Controls Videos Warranty Description Meet Fuzzie – the First Lady of Fuzz. While chilling with her glass of champagne, she brings classy fuzz tone to your guitar signal. This Muse is a sweet combination of vintage and modern. Fuzzie offers a wide range of dirty tones – from mild distortion to dynamic fuzz, rich in harmonics and sustain. This Foxy Lady has the classic vibe and warmth of saturated Germanium transistors, and a clever modern design (with impedance matching circuit) allowing her to be placed either before or after the buffer pedal without losing it’s full, dynamic sound (unlike many of the fuzz pedals). Her ‘Bias’ and ‘Texture’ knobs give you additional tonal flexibility allowing to dial in anything from vintage, super smooth drive to fat and aggressive fuzz. This Muse is a 100% discrete analog circuit designed upon three carefully selected stages, and is equipped with New Old Stock Germanium transistors. Additional information Weight 0.3 kg Dimensions 11.5 × 6 × 5 cm Controls Smooth-Click™ Footswitch : The pedal is equipped with the DeMont Smooth-Click footswitch – the highest quality footswitch on the market – which provides True Bypass operation. Level : Controls the output volume of the pedal. Fuzz : Controls the amount of distortion and sustain. Texture : Controls the tonal characteristics of the pedal. Turn counter-clockwise for smoothest tone. Turn clockwise for fat and saturated fuzz sound. Bias : Modifies the operating point of the circuit for fine tuning the harmonic content, mids and attack. It also allows to compensate for Ge-transistors temperature sensitivity that might alter the tone. Set at 12 o’clock for an “ideal” fuzz setting – creamy and round tone. Turn clockwise or counter-clockwise to dial in the desired character of the pedal. Videos Warranty All Sitek Guitar Electronics pedals come with a 5 year warranty workmanship and components. If your device suddenly stop working please send us an email and we will work it out. Within 5 year the repair will be done free of charge exluding shipping fee. This warranty does not include misuse or accidents resulting in damage. sources.excerpt: Sitek Guitar Electronics Unveils the Fuzzie Germanium Fuzz V2 With Fuzzie Fuzz V2 you get the added 4th 'Texture' mini-knob which goes smoother as you dial it up and more textured CCW Bass Magazine / Dec 3, 2020 Sitek Guitar Electronics Unveils the Fuzzie Germanium Fuzz V2 With Fuzzie Fuzz V2 you get the added 4th 'Texture' mini-knob which goes smoother as you dial it up and more textured CCW Bass Magazine / Dec 3, 2020 Sitek Guitar Electronics take their Fuzzie Germanium Fuzz pedal to the next level with this V2 update. This guitar pedal offers a wide range of dirty tones – from mild distortion to dynamic fuzz, rich in harmonics and sustain. Fuzzie has the classic vibe and warmth of saturated Germanium transistors, and a clever modern design allowing her to be placed either before or after the buffer pedal without losing it’s full, dynamic sound. With Fuzzie Fuzz V2 you get the added 4th ‘Texture’ mini-knob which goes smoother as you dial it up and more textured CCW. Comparing to v1, the output level has been significantly improved. Fuzzie was optimised for extra smooth violin fuzz tones. It’s signature feature is also a distinct low-end accent frequency profile. The update was also highlighted by the new Champagne Sparkle enclosure finish. Features: 4 simple controls: Level, Fuzz, Texture and Bias 100% discrete analog signal path designed with a combination of New Old Stock Germanium transistors and JFET buffer Impedance matching circuit for flexible position in the chain Powder coated enclosure Reverse polarity protection True Bypass Power supply 9V DC or 9V battery Compact footprint Fuzzie Fuzz v2 is available to purchase on Reverb.com or directly from the Sitek Guitar Electronics website at www.sitek.rocks and carry a price of $165.
